overview.text: Kimberly Przekota has served as a Cook County Circuit Court judge in the 11th Subcircuit since February 2025. She presides in the Domestic Violence and Pretrial divisions. She worked as an Assistant Cook County State’s Attorney starting in 2009. She rose to lead prosecutor for murder trials. In August 2026, she ordered a Chicago police officer held in jail before trial on a felony aggravated domestic battery charge.
